terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Single-view approximation for same-frame review only. Reference projection is intentionally not used; confirm framing by render overlay before acceptance.

objectClass.notes: A reference-guided marketing approximation of one cast metallic object; not a manufacturing model.

reasoning: The overall silhouette is simple, but the identity depends on physically readable concentric relief, recessed marks, a wrapped blue line, and multiscale metallic surface breakup.
A shallow hierarchy is sufficient because the object is one cast body and only the whole-object pivot moves.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Macro silhouette, meso identity assemblies, micro relief/material breakup, and one root inspection pivot are all required.

detailInventory.note: Each detail maps to a named component local feature or material local override in the final spec.

definitionOfDone: At the reference camera, the model reads immediately as the same low cast-silver assay monolith rather than a generic rounded box.
The assay bowl, concentric rings, blue line, `Ag / 47`, and three front ticks remain legible at desktop hero size.
Satin-metal highlight breakup survives neutral and grazing light without becoming mirror chrome or flat gray plastic.
Desktop and mobile use the same static fallback; WebGL remains optional and nonblocking.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Hidden underside and rear faces use the same softened cast-metal language with no invented marks.
Normalized object dimensions are 4.8 by 0.72 by 1.7; they communicate proportion, not manufacturing scale.
The blue mark is implemented as a nearly flush inlay because the single view does not establish measurable depth.
The assay bowl and glyph recess depths are tuned by same-camera render comparison rather than claimed physical measurement.

coordinateFrame.front: +Z is the visible long face carrying the three ticks

silhouette.boundingShape: low rounded rectangular cuboid with a slight top crown and broad cast perimeter transition
silhouette.symmetry: approximately bilateral about X and Z at macro scale; surface dents and marks are asymmetric
landmarks: assay well slightly left of center

componentTree.name: Inspection pivot
componentTree.topologyRationale: Invisible unit-scale organizer; it carries no visible geometry and exists only for the whole-object inspection pivot.

collider.notes: Optional pointer-hit proxy only; no physics.

componentTree.name: Cast silver monolith body
componentTree.topologyRationale: The reference shows countable top, front, and end faces joined by simple broad rounded transitions, so a custom rounded cuboid is structurally appropriate.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: custom rounded cuboid with slight crowned-top vertex deformation
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: weighted normals plus independent tangent-space micro normal

localFeatures.geometryEffect: seeded inward offsets <=0.018 without silhouette noise at mobile size

surfaceDetail.displacementPattern: none on mobile; subtle crown in geometry
surfaceDetail.notes: Do not turn the surface into uniform chrome.

componentTree.name: Concentric assay ring relief
componentTree.topologyRationale: Three concentric raised circular rims visibly catch grazing highlights and surround the central recess.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: three concentric torus ridges with shallow intervening grooves

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three concentric rings with decreasing radii and slight height variation

surfaceDetail.notes: Must read by parallax and shadow.

componentTree.name: Recessed assay bowl
componentTree.topologyRationale: The central feature is a rotationally symmetric concave bowl inferred from continuous highlight and shadow gradients.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: lathed shallow concave bowl proxy with dark inner wall

localFeatures.geometryEffect: visible concave negative space with a rounded lip and darkened inner wall

surfaceDetail.notes: A convex plug is a blocking failure.

componentTree.name: Blue calibration inlay
componentTree.topologyRationale: The blue line reads primarily as a flush color boundary; its physical depth is not established by the single image.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: near-flush thin carrier following the top and visible ends
deformationStack: wrap ends over lateral faces in production

localFeatures.placement: rear third of top, wrapping over visible end transitions

surfaceDetail.notes: Preserve a single clean saturated-blue accent.

componentTree.name: Recessed Ag / 47 identity glyphs
componentTree.topologyRationale: A thin carrier is used only as an upstream scaffold; production must replace it with local glyph paths and a shallow recessed/highlight treatment.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: vector glyph decal plus shallow recessed relief proxy
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: glyph relief normal plus metallic interior

localFeatures.geometryEffect: 0.015 shallow recessed glyph strokes with metallic highlight on lower-right edges

surfaceDetail.notes: Grade placement and legibility; exact font source is unavailable.

componentTree.name: Three recessed front ticks
componentTree.topologyRationale: The carrier exists only to organize three shallow front-face grooves; the tick geometry is emitted as a repeated micro system.

localFeatures.geometryEffect: three 0.012-deep vertical grooves with slightly varied height and spacing

surfaceDetail.notes: Do not render as floating black bars.

materials.name: Reference-derived satin silver

albedo.samplingNotes: Palette extracted from masked reference pixels; warm cream reflections remain lighting, not pure albedo.

colorVariation.pattern: low-frequency poured mottle plus directional front-face brushing

textureProjection.texelDensityIntent: Keep micro scratches stable in object space; do not stretch with the 4.8:0.72:1.7 transform.

roughness.map: independent reference-derived roughness plus seeded procedural breakup
roughness.localResponse: 0.24-0.32 on bevel crests; 0.5-0.62 in pits and recesses

normal.pattern: independent reference-derived height plus directional scratch field

ambientOcclusion.notes: Independent AO in assay grooves, bowl, glyphs, and tick recesses.

chips: sparse soft dents on top/end perimeter

referencePbr.hardLimit: Reference-derived inference, not exact inverse rendering or photogrammetry.

shaderNotes: Set albedo texture to SRGBColorSpace; keep roughness/normal/AO as NoColorSpace data.
Cap runtime anisotropy at renderer capability and mobile budget.
Environment reflections explain form but must not turn the surface into mirror chrome.
materials.notes: Extraction passed at 0.86 confidence and still requires render review.

materials.name: Saturated blue calibration inlay

localOverrides.region: top rear third and visible end wraps

materials.notes: Use one precise accent; no glow or bloom.

materials.name: Darkened recessed metal
materials.notes: For cavity depth and glyph/tick troughs; do not use as a flat black decal.

repetitionSystems.distributionRule: Three coaxial rings with decreasing radius; never three coincident copies.
Three vertical grooves with slight nonuniform spacing and height, aligned on the front face.

acceptance: Macro, meso, and repeated structures meet qualityContract.minimumSpecDepth.
Parent-child relations, joints, seams, sockets, and contact points are explicit.
Every attached child appendage/connector has parentSocket, localStart/localEnd, contactType, embedDepth or overlap, and gapTolerance.

buildPasses.goal: Refine shape, deformation, bevels, tapers, curves, asymmetry, and visible local geometry.
acceptance: Important visible forms are represented in component geometryDescriptor, deformations, localFeatures, or repetitionSystems.
Endpoint-based child parts are rooted at their attachment sockets and do not visibly float away from parents.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Lazy-load only after the static image is visible; pause offscreen/hidden, cap DPR and shadows, and reduce ring/surface detail on coarse-pointer devices without removing identity marks.

lightingFromPhoto: key light: large warm area source from upper-front-left, soft shadow, intensity target 2.0 relative
fill light: broad warm-neutral hemisphere/environment reflection, intensity target 0.55 relative
rim light: restrained cool blue-gray directional fill from rear-right, intensity target 0.35 relative
exposure and tone mapping: ACES Filmic, exposure 0.9-1.05, preserve satin highlights without clipping
background and contact shadow: cream #EEE3D4 ground/backdrop with a soft low-opacity shadow falling camera-right/back
proceduralStrategy: Build a custom rounded cuboid with a slight top crown before adding any marks.
Create the assay well as real concentric relief plus a concave lathed bowl; reject a flat target texture.
Add the blue wrapped line, recessed vector glyphs, and front tick grooves as separate named surface systems.
Use the 0.86-confidence PBR extraction as evidence, then author independent object-space albedo, roughness, normal, and AO fields that exclude the cream background.
Match the reference camera and warm-key/cool-rim lighting in a browser render before micro-detail tuning.
After visual acceptance, enforce the mobile triangle, draw-call, texture, DPR, and frame-rate budgets.
animationAnchors: root pivot supports only restrained pointer-linked yaw/pitch and spring return
all visible identity parts remain locked to the monolith; there is no explode or autonomous spin
destructionAnchors: none: the marketing object is intentionally nonbreakable and nonphysical
risks: The upstream generator's plain BoxGeometry cannot produce the required cast rounded body without manual tailoring.
The upstream repetition emitter supports radial placement, not true concentric scale or linear tick spacing; generated systems require replacement.
The glyph carrier is not a faithful Ag / 47 relief until production vector paths are authored.
Single-image PBR evidence includes lighting inference and requires same-camera render review.

localSpecSearch.query: cast metal monolith rounded cuboid concentric relief
